name: Deceptive (Legendary Games)
body:
Price +1 bonus; Slot none; CL 3rd; Weight —; Aura faint illusion

DESCRIPTION

A deceptive weapon seems to evade notice even when looking right at it. The wielder adds twice the weapon’s enhancement bonus on Sleight of Hand or Stealth checks made to hide the weapon from view. The wielder also adds this bonus to the DC of Diplomacy or Heal checks made to gather information about the weapon or wounds inflicted by it. In addition, when the wielder strikes an opponent that is flat-footed or unaware of him with a deceptive weapon, the wielder can implant a mystical glamour that confuses divination spells that may be used later to gather information about the attack. This functions like misdirection, except the wielder decides the first time he strikes the target what false information will be revealed to divination effects used to examine wounds made by the weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost +1 bonus; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells misdirection
